text:
sam_support: P1 — FathomCare trial blocked: SSO flow returning 401 for all users; blocked activation; renewal conversation in 2 weeks. Raising to CS for immediate handoff.
priya_csm: FYI — I'm assigned. What's the help needed from CS vs support-engineering?
sam_support: Support found source: SAML assertion failing after IdP change. Ticket SUP-3421. Carlos, can you paste minimal repro?
carlos_se: Here's the failing curl & response:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/auth/validate
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid_token","detail":"SAML audience mismatch"}
```
maya_supportmgr: Marking P1 and adding infra-oncall. We need a comms plan to the customer — do not leave them in limbo.
jordan_ae: On it — I'll ping the customer's technical lead and offer a call. Priya, can you lead the handoff and own proactive renewal risk comms?
priya_csm: Yes. Plan: 1) Immediate workaround: issue time-limited API key (temp_key_XXXXX) so tenant can continue ingest for 48h. 2) Schedule deep-dive with FathomCare + Carlos + infra in next 90 min. 3) Post-call, send formal comms and updated timeline to AE/Customer. 4) Log action items in CS playbook and add renewal flag.
sam_support: Workaround ready — temp API key created in SUP-3421 comment. I pasted usage snippet:
```
# temp key usage
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=temp_key_XXXXX
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ingest
```
priya_csm: Great — I'll DM the customer with the workaround and schedule link. Jordan, please confirm timeslot.
jordan_ae: Confirmed 11:30 PT with customer. I'll join and own commercial comms. Priya, please update playbook with steps and owners.
carlos_se: Root cause appears to be the IdP metadata change; quick fix is to re-add our SP audience to their IdP config. I'll draft the exact steps to send during the call.
priya_csm: Comms draft: "We're escalating this as P1. Temporary API key issued for 48h to keep things running. We'll have a technical call at 11:30 PT to finalize SSO reconciliation; expect full fix within 8 business hours post-call. CSM action items: run post-mortem, add renewal watch flag, and coordinate credits if needed." Thoughts?
jordan_ae: Sounds good. Also propose offering a one-week trial extension if resolution pushes past EOD to protect renewal.
maya_supportmgr: Approve extension offer. Carlos — after the call, open JIRA INF-7890 for the config mismatch and tag for a config change review.
carlos_se: Will open INF-7890 and assign to infra-oncall. I'll also attach IdP metadata diff.
ops_bot: New incident created: SUP-3421 -> linked INF-7890. Priority: P1. Pager notified.
priya_csm: Action owners: Priya — customer comms + post-mortem, Jordan — commercial touch, Carlos — technical fix + JIRA, Sam — maintain temp key and monitoring. I'll send the comms now and update thread after call.
sam_support: Thanks team. I'll monitor logs and post any regression. Keeping thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
